name: JoinBot
tagline: Join meetings and answer out loud
description: JoinBot lets an agent join Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls as a named participant that answers out loud when someone says its name, posts links to the meeting chat and reads the transcript afterwards. Sign in with a JoinBot account, or paste a workspace connect key.

prompts.text: Join this Google Meet and answer questions about our roadmap: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
Summarise the meeting you just left and list the action items.

apps.name: JoinBot
apps.description: Meeting join, live listening, spoken answers, meeting chat and transcripts, over JoinBot's MCP server.
